title: spermacoce savannarum
intro: Spermacoce savannarum, commonly known as Savanna buttonweed, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to tropical and subtropical regions of the world. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce savannarum include wound healing, reducing fever, and treating various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
